<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="15" x2="326" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="13" x2="331" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="11" x2="336" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="16" x2="351" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="360" y="10" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="12" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#15451F"/>
  <rect x="383" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="30,59 22,66 30,73" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="66" x2="42" y2="66" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="61" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Travel setup</text>
    <text x="195" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Personalize your lessons</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="105" width="342" height="10" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="24" y="105" width="114" height="10" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <circle cx="138" cy="110" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="24" y="135" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Step 1 of 3</text>
    <text x="366" y="135" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">33% complete</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main title -->
  <text x="24" y="180" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you going?</text>
  <text x="24" y="208" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">We’ll help you learn the words you’ll use</text>
  <text x="24" y="231" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">on your trip.</text>

  <!-- Trip illustration card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="250" width="340" height="112" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="24" y="248" width="340" height="112" rx="14" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="274" r="18" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <polygon points="45,336 91,292 123,320 157,283 218,336" fill="#9DAD88"/>
    <polygon points="118,336 157,283 205,336" fill="#6F6F70"/>
    <polygon points="144,297 157,283 170,297" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="45" y="321" width="175" height="15" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="275" cy="306" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="275" y1="313" x2="275" y2="333" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="265" y1="321" x2="285" y2="321" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="238" y="344" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your next adventure</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination label -->
  <text x="24" y="397" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Destination</text>
  <text x="366" y="397" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Required</text>

  <!-- Search/input -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="410" width="342" height="54" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="24" y="408" width="342" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="434" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="56" y1="441" x2="63" y2="448" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="77" y="440" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Enter a city or country</text>
  </g>
  <text x="24" y="486" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Try “Paris”, “Montreal”, or “Nice”</text>

  <!-- Suggested destination -->
  <text x="24" y="528" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Popular destination</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="542" width="340" height="74" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="24" y="540" width="340" height="74" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- French flag -->
    <rect x="42" y="558" width="16" height="38" rx="4" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="58" y="558" width="16" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="74" y="558" width="16" height="38" rx="4" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="106" y="571" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">France</text>
    <text x="106" y="593" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">French for travelers</text>
    <polyline points="335,573 342,580 335,587" fill="none" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Selected language hint -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="635" width="342" height="50" rx="13" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="660" r="12" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="42,660 47,665 55,655" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="657" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your course language</text>
    <text x="72" y="675" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">French</text>
    <text x="348" y="666" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Change</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue area -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="705" width="342" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="735" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="778" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose a destination to continue</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="796" width="390" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="796" x2="374" y2="796" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,813 49,805 59,813 59,824 39,824" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="37,813 49,802 61,813" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="49" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Learn -->
    <g>
      <rect x="124" y="805" width="20" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="128" y1="810" x2="140" y2="810" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="128" y1="815" x2="138" y2="815" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="134" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">Learn</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Practice -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="230" cy="814" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="230,806 232,812 238,812 233,816 235,822 230,818 225,822 227,816 222,812 228,812" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="230" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="334" cy="810" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="334" cy="824" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="334" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
